title: centaurea dufourii subsp. lagascae
intro: Centaurea dufourii subsp. lagascae, commonly known as Spanish knapweed or Lagasque's knapweed, is a plant species in the Asteraceae family. This plant is traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal problems, due to its health benefits. Its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The plant's bioactive compounds may also exhibit immunomodulatory and free radical scavenging activities, making it a potential source of natural remedies for various diseases.
